panel.label: Rez Effects
panel.name: rezfx

combo_box.name: rezfx_in_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: What objects do when they appear. They are drawn whole and solid from their first frame: the effect only paints the surface. Exception: the 3D printer and the transporter hide what is not built yet (it cannot be clicked), unless combat-safe applies.

combo_box.item.label: Random mix of the ticked ones
combo_box.item.name: in_random

combo_box.name: rezfx_out_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: What objects do when they are removed. A removed object keeps drawing only for the effect: it casts no shadow and cannot be clicked.

combo_box.item.label: Random mix of the ticked ones
combo_box.item.name: out_random

panel.text: Tick = in the random mix. Swatch = glow colour.

check_box.label: Tron
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_tron
check_box.tool_tip: A cyan wireframe scan climbs the object, then a second scan fills in its textured surface. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Fire
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_fire
check_box.tool_tip: The object burns into view: a glowing front eats away a charred skin. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Hologram
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_hologram
check_box.tool_tip: Scanlines, flicker and a slight colour split that settle into the real surface. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Voxel assemble
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_voxel
check_box.tool_tip: The surface assembles from glowing cubes, bottom to top. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: 3D printer
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_printer
check_box.tool_tip: Prints the object layer by layer under a print head on a gantry that zig-zags across each layer: the cut top is solid, with infill lines and a glowing fresh bead; fresh layers cool as filament ridges; the unprinted part is a faint ghost. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Transporter
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_transporter
check_box.tool_tip: A beam of light with spiralling sparkles; the object shimmers in from sparkles and interference bands, flashes as it becomes solid and glows off. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Ember burn
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_ember
check_box.tool_tip: Burns away from glowing edges. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Disintegrate
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_disintegrate
check_box.tool_tip: Glowing seams split it into cubes that break loose in a wave and fly apart, spinning and falling, with glow trails. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Ash on the wind
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_ash
check_box.tool_tip: Burns away behind a curling, flickering ember edge; glowing flakes peel off, drift with the region wind, cool to grey and fade, with a little smoke. Ticked: part of the random mix.

color_swatch.name: rezfx_color_ash
color_swatch.tool_tip: Glow colour of Ash on the wind.

check_box.label: Glitch out
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_glitch
check_box.tool_tip: Blocks jump, the colours split, then it blinks out. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Implode
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_implode
check_box.tool_tip: Collapses into its centre and ends in a short flash. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Tron de-rez
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_tron_out
check_box.tool_tip: Tron in reverse: a scan turns the surface back into a glowing wireframe, it flickers, then the lines wink out from the top down. Uses the Tron glow strength and line width. Ticked: part of the random mix.

check_box.label: Shatter
check_box.name: rezfx_mix_shatter
check_box.tool_tip: Glowing cracks race across it from the side facing you, then it breaks into glass shards that fall, tumble, glint and fade. Ticked: part of the random mix.

slider.label: Effect duration (s):
slider.name: rezfx_duration
slider.tool_tip: How long an effect takes. Tron: the fill scan (its wireframe scan takes 0.6 of this, and the wireframe waits up to 2 s more for textures, or longer with Finish rez-ins only after textures have loaded). The 3D printer takes about 5.8 times this (3.5 s at the default, 8 s at most) and the transporter 1.5 times (6 s at most). Disintegrate takes 1.8 times this; ash, Tron de-rez and shatter twice; a de-rez lasts 1.2 s at most.

check_box.label: Rez-in only for objects still loading their textures
check_box.name: rezfx_only_loading
check_box.tool_tip: An object whose textures are already loaded (one you rez while building) just appears. Avatars and attachments always play the rez-in.

check_box.label: Avatars and attachments too (rigged mesh included)
check_box.name: rezfx_avatars
check_box.tool_tip: Avatars arriving and what they wear play the rez-in; an attachment taken off plays the de-rez. A leaving avatar just goes.

check_box.label: Finish rez-ins only after textures have loaded
check_box.name: rezfx_wait_textures
check_box.tool_tip: A two-part rez-in plays its first part, then holds there, idling, until the object's textures have loaded (an avatar: its skin and clothes), then finishes. Tron holds its wireframe, the hologram its projection, voxel its blocks, the 3D printer before its final layers, the transporter its sparkles, fire its smouldering shell. Never longer than 30 s from the start, and never on combat-safe land. Off: Tron's wireframe waits at most 2 s, the others never wait.

slider.label: Tron glow strength:
slider.name: rezfx_tron_glow
slider.tool_tip: How brightly Tron's wireframe and scan line glow. 0: plain lines with no glow; 1: the default; up to 4.

slider.label: Tron line width (px):
slider.name: rezfx_tron_line_width
slider.tool_tip: Width of Tron's wireframe lines on screen, in pixels.

check_box.label: Combat-safe: on damage-enabled land, shorten every effect to 0.25 s
check_box.name: rezfx_combat_safe
check_box.tool_tip: Where the land you stand on allows damage, no effect lasts longer than 0.25 s (no rez-in waits for textures there), and the 3D printer and transporter keep the object whole and solid, paint only.

panel.text: Printer and transporter hide unbuilt parts. Temp objects never play effects.
